title: An unanswered gate its session just added can be reworded or removed with a backlog.py command
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: the ST-tudbg2a6 research worker's gate question named gitlab, which classed it as a push gate only the operator answers; with no command to edit or remove a gate it reverted the item file and added the gate again. backlog.py removes or rewords an unanswered gate (re-classing it), refusing an answered one.
notes: SP-2vhfsn4o evidence: three workers added a gate the classifier made blocking with no command to remove it; one hand-edited the item JSON to drop it (BG-ovvvqtxf), one stopped with a stray g2 its repro added (BG-jj2nc5ou). Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 8 of 13, "Gates: commands, classing and host checks"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers.
